help:
O'So AI Relay links your PrestaShop shop to an AI running on this computer.

Usage: oso <command> [arguments] [--lang en|fr|es|de]

Commands:
  ui                     open the interface
  pair <shop> <code>     link a shop with the code shown in its back office
  ai <address>           set the address of the local AI and test it
  ai stop|start|free     stop or start your local AI, or free its memory
  run                    run the relay in this window
  install / uninstall    start or stop starting with this computer
  start / stop           start or stop the background relay
  status                 show the shop, the AI and the relay
  addtopath              install oso for your account and type it from any folder
  llm list               list the models of the local AI
  llm test [model]       check that a model can call tools
  llm install <model>    download a model into Ollama
  llm setup ollama|lmstudio
                         install a local AI and a model, then test it
  version                show the version
  help                   show this help
llm.no_model: No model installed in the local AI.
llm.test_fail: %s cannot call tools: it will not be offered in the shop.
ollama.missing: Ollama does not answer at %s. Install it from the official site, %s, then try again.
path.added: oso is installed in %s and added to your PATH. Open a new terminal and type: oso ui. You can delete the downloaded files.
path.already: oso is up to date in %s, already on your PATH. Type in a new terminal: oso ui. You can delete the downloaded files.
power.freed: Memory freed: the model loads again at the next question.
power.started: Your AI answers again and the relay is back.
power.stopped: Everything is stopped: your AI is closed and the relay paused.
power.unknown: Only Ollama and LM Studio can be stopped and started from here.

run.start: Relay running for %s, with the AI at %s. Ctrl+C to stop.
run.unlinked: The shop revoked this relay: link it again.
service.installed: Installed: the relay starts with this computer.
service.uninstalled: Removed: the relay no longer starts with this computer.
service.unsupported: Starting with the computer is not available on %s.
setup.test: Testing the model with the shop's tools...

ui.setup.intro: Pick one and click: the relay downloads it from its official site, installs it for your account only, starts it, downloads a model suited to this computer and tests it. Nothing else to do. Several GB to download.
ui.setup.lmstudio: LM Studio's server, without its window.

ui.setup.ollama: Light, runs quietly in the background.
ui.shop.intro: In the back office: Built-in assistant › Add a local assistant. Copy the address and the code shown there.
ui.shop.note: The relay connects to the shop going out, like a browser: nothing is opened on your network.
ui.shop.paste: Paste the command shown in the back office into either field: the address and the code fill in and the link starts.
ui.shop.revoked: The shop unlinked this relay. Link it again with a new code from the back office.
ui.shop.title: Link your shop
ui.status.note: The relay only calls the AI address typed here, never an address sent by the shop.
